name: Grow Therapy
one_liner: Browse and book in-network therapists and prescribers by video or in person, and pay your insurance copay per session.
best_for: Adults and teens with commercial insurance who want weekly therapy for their copay
People who want to choose their own therapist from profiles rather than be assigned one
People who want medication management from an in-network prescriber (some states)
People who want the option of in-person sessions with some providers
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People without insurance on a tight budget (self-pay is usually $75 to $200 a session)
People who want unlimited messaging or text-based therapy
People who do not want advertising cookies on a therapy website
short_description: A directory of independent therapists and prescribers who bill your insurance; you book a session and pay your copay.
long_description: Grow Therapy is a US marketplace of independent licensed therapists and psychiatric prescribers who are credentialed with insurance plans through Grow. You filter by insurance, state, specialty and availability, book a session online, and see the provider by video or, with some providers, in person. Grow bills your plan, and you pay your share: its own guide says people using insurance on Grow typically pay $0 to $50 a session, and that you may pay the full rate until your deductible is met. If your plan is out of network you are billed the provider's self-pay rate, which Grow says usually runs from about $75 to $200 or more. Medication management is offered only in some states, and Medicare and Medicaid are accepted only in some states. The iOS app lets you book, join sessions and message your provider, and includes an AI 'coach' between sessions (not for minors or in some states). Grow's privacy notice says its advertising cookies may count as a 'sale' or 'sharing' of personal information under California law.
patient_summary: You search Grow Therapy's directory for a licensed therapist or psychiatric prescriber who takes your insurance, book online, and meet by video or in person. With insurance you pay your copay, coinsurance or deductible each session (Grow puts the typical range at $0 to $50); without coverage you pay the provider's self-pay rate, usually about $75 to $200.

pricing.notes: No subscription or platform fee for clients. You pay your plan's copay, coinsurance or deductible; before the deductible is met you may pay the full session rate. Out-of-network clients pay the provider's self-pay rate, which each provider sets. Grow cites 100+ to 125+ accepted plans; Medicare and Medicaid only in some states.

privacy.notes: Privacy notice says its advertising cookies and web beacons may be a 'sale' or 'sharing' under California law and lists ad networks among recipients (opt-out available); clients can request deletion via a form, though medical records are kept (about 10 years); clinical records fall under its HIPAA notice.

seo.title: Grow Therapy: Find a Therapist Who Takes Your Insurance
seo.meta_description: Grow Therapy connects patients with licensed therapists who accept insurance, offering in-network therapy with no out-of-pocket costs for many.

faqs.q: Is Grow Therapy really free with insurance?
faqs.a: With in-network insurance coverage, many patients pay $0-30 per session depending on their plan. Grow Therapy works with most major insurers. The platform verifies benefits before matching you with therapists to ensure affordability.

faqs.q: How is Grow Therapy different from BetterHelp?
faqs.a: Unlike BetterHelp's subscription model, Grow Therapy works with insurance for per-session billing like traditional therapy. This means potentially lower costs if you have good insurance. Grow Therapy offers scheduled video sessions rather than messaging-based care.

faqs.q: What kinds of therapists are on Grow Therapy?
faqs.a: Grow Therapy has licensed therapists (LCSWs, LMFTs, LPCs, psychologists) with various specialties including anxiety, depression, trauma, relationships, and more. The platform emphasizes diverse providers from different backgrounds and approaches.

faqs.q: Can I choose my therapist on Grow Therapy?
faqs.a: Yes, you browse therapist profiles filtered by specialty, approach, insurance, and availability. You can see photos, videos, and detailed bios before booking. If a match isn't right, you can switch therapists easily.

primary_uses: Weekly therapy with an in-network therapist
Medication management with an in-network prescriber (some states)
Therapy for anxiety, depression, trauma and relationship issues

availability.note: US only; therapists in all 50 states. Prescribers only in some states; Medicare and Medicaid only in some states.
